_comment: The new WSL distribution's additions to adoption/mcp/claude-user.json. Only tools/adoption/new_wsl_client_config.py reads this file: it merges the servers below into the shared template (a server both files name is refused) and wires each through adoption/new-wsl/client-config-map.json, so the shared template stays what install_claude_profile.py registers on every other host. semble 0.6.1 is the code-search slot's interim install there (definitive manifest, amendment 3; wave-2 code-search ruling, changes 4 and 5): the uv tool's `semble` console script, with the pinned model's local snapshot as SEMBLE_MODEL_NAME and Claude Code's own absolute SEMBLE_CACHE_LOCATION (Codex's entry, in codex.config.additions.toml beside this file, names semble-codex): a cache shared by two processes can keep serving an index another process rebuilt.
